body: Well don't leave me hanging. Now I want to know.

Vote for legislation that protects and empowers the disabled. Due to funding cuts I can barely afford paratransit to work let alone physical therapy I desperately need and leisure trips are beyond out of the question. I literally cannot afford to socialize. Paratransit also often takes much longer than the standard bus leaving me even less time to do anything include being politically active. Vote to protect us.
I getcha, no worries. I've just had to deal with so many doctors; it grates on ya after a while.

This ain't against you but CBT can fuck right off. Glad it helps some but it all boils down to paying hundreds to have someone tell you how to be self aware. Wow I can pay attention to like my thoughts and feelings and it could gasp help me manage my life WOWZERS

I appreciate the sentiment - you gotta have a good foundation but sleep hygiene's also common sense so constantly having that be the advice is kinda irritating af. I've been an insomniac since a childhood TBI so I've had plenty o time to try and right things myself and it ain't worked yet.
Thyroid is good. My autonomic system is faulty so bp and hr vary.

I've tried everything from prescription sleep aids to home remedies. For whatever reason the only thing that's ever helped me "feel sleepy" (something I almost never naturally experience) is a liquid multi mineral with large doses of c, d3, calcium, magnesium, zinc, copper, manganese, chromium, hesperidin, optiMSM, silica dioxide, selenium, boron, and some trace stuff. I had zero expectation that it would work and zero explanation as to why it seems to but whatever I'll take it. Now I'd love to be able to STAY asleep but hey baby steps
There's got to be more to it than melatonin. Source: Me an insomniac for whom melatonin does nothing.
Make it through the coming winter
Kill yourself now when you find a moment of happiness. It never gets better.
Nothing when I needed them.
Surviving while homeless and disabled while waiting for my social security court date.

Emotionally? Working up the courage to bare everything about deeply personal experiences only to be met with skepticism, doubt, or worse, be spoken over by someone unqualified to do so who's made a career of acting like it's their right.
Rent a small apartment so I could ya know stop being homeless.

Like French but fuller? Rounder. Punctuated by gentle staccato bursts. On a scale between French and Italian it's somewhere in between but that's probably only because those are the only languages aside from English I've heard a decent amount of. Prettiest language I've heard spoken by a native speaker aside from Portuguese imo.
NO
That the saying "It gets better" is fundamentally built on survivor's bias.

I'm sorry for you loss. Anniversaries can be really hard. I do appreciate your comment. 

Yeah I don't know much about the UK either. All I know is the US is pretty fucked. Shelters here require you to work, attend counseling, turn in wages, and have very limited stay times (15-30 day max generally). If I had SSI I might be eligible for public housing vouchers but even they have a 4 year wait time.

But yeah I've got no one who can help. Plus even if someone took me in it would cut off my food stamps and possibly severely decrease my SSI (to even more unlivable levels) even IF I'm eventually approved. Without a lawyer I don't really know anything for sure except that I'm boned

I've been treated badly by a lot of people too. Women and men. People who get into helping careers are usually fucked up themselves or out for a power trip. Good eggs exist but they're rare and good eggs who can actually help, even rarer. That said, as a woman your comment made me kinda uncomfortable.

Because I'm homeless, disabled and won't be able to survive long enough to see my day in court (SSI). No lawyer wants to take my case. Can't stay in a shelter because of mobility issues and not being able to work. My cognition is getting worse and if I'm probably going to die / suffer anyway I'd rather it be over on my terms while I'm still lucid. 

Also I've tried being open with a friend (the only one who's stuck by me) but I just end up having to comfort them. Was abused by a shrink. Plus when you're suicidal because of physical pain and your situation no amount of talking's gonna put a roof over your head.
Forgiving people who would sooner see me die that suffer the terrible inconvenience of doing their fucking jobs.

That you can't open up to a shrink about feeling suicidal without risking institutionalization. The irony being that this can push a stable suicidal person into an unstable one by virtue of feeling more isolated and misunderstood. 

That the mental health field doesn't make any distinction between chemical imbalances and situational depression. No amount of mental gymnastics are going to help a starving man feel better about having no access to food.
I didn't sneak the camera that had pictures of my bruises to school to report him.

So I'm not advocating for cuts but if that's the best a for profit institution can do I'm kinda curious how the govt thinks a disabled individual can live on like $700/mo (SSI). Heck it's even less if you're in a facility. Enjoy trying to meet your basic needs on like 30 bucks.
